humanFeedbackVerbatim: B matches my expectations -- generally I expect all things on the board to be laid out in an easy to understand format with the compositions, and that tell me a story to the conclusion -- story needs to be compelling to read and engage with - must be very insightful and --- just alway remember that comment from the IKEA case -- that was beautiful for me as a human to read -- especially in its delivery
agreement: The proposed B update uses the new announcement, preserves the user's earlier hypothesis and its meaning, and resolves identity without rewriting the past.

presentationStandard.userExpectation: An easy-to-understand native canvas composition that tells a compelling, engaging, insightful story to its conclusion; the IKEA comment's explanatory delivery is an inspiration.
proposedObservableCriteria: The reader can identify the central question, main insight and current conclusion from the canvas itself.
The explanation connects evidence to a mechanism or interpretation and explains why the conclusion matters; it does not merely display a source inventory or summarize each source independently.
Visual hierarchy, wording, spacing and relevant media create a legible reading path without requiring every investigative step to be narrated chronologically.
Decisive evidence is easy to inspect near the claims it supports; unresolved questions and meaningful earlier hypotheses remain accessible without obscuring the main explanation.
Writing is specific, engaging and economical. A memorable formulation earns credit only when it accurately captures the reasoning.
Meaningful objects remain individually selectable and editable. Relationships use native connectors only when these improve clarity.
avoid: Mandating a fixed layout, a connector diagram, a particular writing style, or a falsely resolved conclusion.
Treating the IKEA commenter as factual gold or requiring its wording.
Equating accurate but generic cautious prose with an insightful explanation.
Claiming rendered-canvas narrative quality from a prose excerpt alone.

remainingWork: Gymshark and Slack calibration, consolidation of proposed rubric refinements, and actual rendered-canvas evaluation remain outstanding. Agreement on this update is not whole-case or benchmark approval.
